verses.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਵੇਦਾਂ ਸਣੈ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: brahamaadhik vedhaa(n) sanai net net kar bhedh na paiaa|

en.bdb: Brahmas alongwith the Vedas have declared Him this is not, this is not (neti neti) and these all could not known His mystery.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਅਵਧੂਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਨ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: mahaadhev avadhoot hoi namo namo kar dhiaan na aaiaa|

en.bdb: By becoming avadhut (a kind of superior yogi), Madadev also recited his name but his meditation could not attain him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dhas avataar akaar kar eka(n)kaar na alakh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: Ten incarnations also flourished but none could perceive ekhankar, the supreme Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਥ ਨਉ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: ridh sidh nidh naath nau aadh purakh aadhes karaiaa|

en.bdb: Nine naths, the treasures of miraculous powers, also bowed before that Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਨਾਂਵ ਲੈ ਸਹਸ ਮੁਖ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸੰਖ ਨ ਨਾੳਂੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sahas naa(n)v lai sahas mukh simaran sa(n)kh na naau(n) dhiaaiaa|

en.bdb: Sesang (mythical snake) with its thousand mouths remembered Him by thousands of names, but its recitation could not be accomplished.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਮਸ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਾਧਿ ਨ ਸਾਧੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: lomas tap kar saadhanaa haumai saadh na saadh sadhaiaa|

en.bdb: Sage Lomas rigorously undertook ascetic discipline but could not overcome his ego and could not be called a true ascetic.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਬਹੁ ਹੰਢਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁਫਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਨ ਚਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: chir jeevan bahu ha(n)ddanaa gurmukh sukhufal pal na chakhaiaa|

en.bdb: Ever-living Markandey spent a long life but could not taste the pleasure fruit of the gurmukhs.
All mentioned above remained deluded while living on earth.
